    Deck translations of representable modules #

    Inverse precomposition sends the covariant representable at X to the covariant representable at the correspondingly shifted object. Consequently, freeness of the deck action on isomorphism classes of category objects gives trivial deck stabilizers for finite-dimensional representables.

    Freeness of an action on categorical vertices, i.e. on isomorphism classes of objects rather than only on the underlying object type.
